description: This file defines classes and functions related to WebTransport over HTTP/3 in the QUIC protocol implementation, including session management, stream handling, and error remapping.

classes.name: WebTransportHttp3
classes.description: Manages a WebTransport session over HTTP/3, including stream association, session state, and error handling.

classes.name: WebTransportHttp3UnidirectionalStream
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/3 unidirectional stream used in WebTransport sessions.

methods.name: HeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming headers for the WebTransport session.

methods.name: SetVisitor
methods.description: Sets the visitor for session events.

methods.name: AssociateStream
methods.description: Associates a stream ID with the session.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes the WebTransport session with an error code and message.

methods.name: OpenOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Opens a new outgoing bidirectional stream.

methods.name: GetStreamById
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by its ID.

methods.name: SetDatagramMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Sets the maximum time a datagram can stay in the queue.

methods.name: WritePreamble
methods.description: Sends stream type and session ID.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles data availability on the stream.

methods.name: Http3ErrorToWebTransport
methods.description: Maps HTTP/3 error codes to WebTransport error codes.

methods.name: Http3ErrorToWebTransportOrDefault
methods.description: Maps HTTP/3 error codes to WebTransport error codes with default fallback.

methods.name: WebTransportErrorToHttp3
methods.description: Maps WebTransport error codes to HTTP/3 error codes.
